answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 15 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in pigment, checked in onyx, and harbor reveals each void. A farm of 2972 identities would post 812 proofs and burn roughly 6 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
